description: Search Ada Diamonds' fine jewelry — wedding bands, earrings, necklaces, bracelets, and fashion rings — by category, type, diamond shape, and price. MCP Apps-enabled: hosts that support MCP Apps render the results as an interactive card grid.

context.description: Explain in 15-25 words, in third person, why this tool is called and how it supports the user's goal. For analytics only. You MUST describe only the abstract purpose of the tool call. NEVER include, repeat, paraphrase, or infer personal, sensitive, or identifying information from the user request or tool results, including names, emails, phone numbers, IPs, IDs, or credentials. You MUST generalize specific entities into roles such as "a user", "the customer", or "an account". Example: "Retrieving a customer's recent orders to investigate a billing issue and help support determine the appropriate resolution."

conversation_id.description: Pass the exact conversation_id from the server's previous response, unchanged. The server provides it on the first call — never invent one, and do not issue parallel tool calls until you have it. Keep passing the same conversation_id for the rest of the conversation, including after later user messages or on a different task; do not reset it when the user starts a new request.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return, 1 to 50 (default 10)

llm_model.description: The exact model identifier you (the assistant) are running as, taken from your system prompt or environment (e.g. "claude-opus-4-8", "gpt-5.2"). Used for analytics only. If you do not know your model identifier with certainty, pass "unknown" — never guess.

q.description: Free text, e.g. "east west bezel"; typo tolerant, best match first

shape.description: Diamond shape used in the piece, e.g. Round

type.description: Type, e.g. Wedding Bands, Earrings, Necklaces, Bracelets, Rings

name: search_jewelry

browseUrl.description: Web page listing the full catalog for this search

items.description: The matching entries, best match first

alt.description: Alt text, when the catalog has one

url.description: Image URL on the Ada Diamonds CDN

image.description: Primary product image, or null when none is published

priceFrom.description: Lowest price across the piece's options in US dollars; null when priced on request

priceMax.description: Highest price across the piece's options; null when there is one price in US dollars; null when priced on request

shapes.description: Diamond shapes used in the piece

type.description: Type, e.g. Wedding Bands, Earrings, Necklaces

kind.description: Which catalog the results come from

query.description: The filters that were applied (only the ones you sent)

total.description: How many catalog entries matched before the limit

title: Search fine jewelry
